end.summary:
Practised how earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil.
Discussed how soil animals help turn dead leaves into rich soil.
Pihu initially called earthworms insects and harmful pests that spoil soil.
By the last response, Pihu stated that tunnels let air and water into soil; the pest mix-up remained earlier in the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the idea that earthworm tunnels make pathways for air and water in soil, and that soil animals help turn dead leaves into rich soil. Pihu used the tunnel-and-pot example to reach the air-and-water explanation. They continued to describe worms as harmful and needing removal, so at home, ask Pihu to explain one way earthworms help soil and why farmers may keep them.
